push.title: W 3-0 vs Paris Saint Bal | You: 7.0 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.0. You've got more in the tank, and we're gonna go find it together.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Paris Saint Bal. You didn't hesitate, and the keeper didn't stand a chance.
+ Man of the Match. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.
+ That 7.0 sits as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (2 vs their best 1). That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of Paris Saint Bal. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Here's what helps: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Habits beat highlights.
- 67% passing (2 of 3). Here's how: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Believe.
- Rating came in 0.6 below what your on-ball stats earned. Little adjustment: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- defensive work rate hit you and BellyTb1 both. Partner drill: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Key passes: 0. Good. Great starts at 2+.

Five minutes of this: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

Last thing, buddskees. Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
A 6.9, PhogsToffees. Breathe. We'll look at the tape, find one thing, and fix it.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ You and buddskees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Giveaways 2, down from your usual 7. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ Won your matchup: 6.9 against their best forward's 5.8. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- No shots. Tiny tweak: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run. Rome, day by day.
- 60% passing (3 of 5, down from your usual 76%). Quick fix: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Fix it and forget it.
- Your 5th worst match performance of the season (6.9). We'll get you back up the list.
- Both you and buddskees dipped on forcing passes. Lean on each other: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

Kickabout task: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Brick by brick. - Coach Lasso
